failure_modes.trigger: Recovery reopens raw maps, invokes the estimator, mutates raw inputs, or stages private evidence.
failure_modes.consequence: The preserved scientific execution is changed or canonical inputs are corrupted.
failure_modes.detection: raw_maps_reopened=false; staged-path scan; pre/post raw identity unchanged

failure_modes.trigger: Processed files merely belong to WU-004 inventory but do not match the exact observed/mask/300 CMB/300 noise role and row graph.
failure_modes.consequence: Accepted provenance can be satisfied by a wrong but admitted file.

failure_modes.trigger: Checkpoint payload bytes or decoded arrays change without sidecar failure, or post-hoc-bound checkpoints are reused as authority.
failure_modes.consequence: A tampered or retrospectively blessed checkpoint can enter the result.
failure_modes.detection: bound-checkpoint tamper test plus checkpoint_reused_count=0 disposition

failure_modes.trigger: Committed replay accepts numerical equivalence when the frozen scalar NPZ or a declared portable artifact byte identity differs.
failure_modes.consequence: The replay no longer verifies the exact frozen evidence object.

failure_modes.trigger: Terminal claims SUCCEEDED/P0=0/P1=0 before an external fresh review receipt is content-bound.
failure_modes.consequence: The implementer self-issues acceptance despite reproduced findings.

failure_modes.trigger: PMG-WU-006 starts before the reviewed PMG-WU-005 terminal is committed and remotely readable.
failure_modes.consequence: Downstream analysis consumes unaccepted carrier evidence.
failure_modes.detection: next-step precondition requires reviewed terminal format and remote readback MATCH

failure_modes.trigger: The documented replay command fails in a clean checkout or the legacy self-attested finalizer remains reachable.
failure_modes.consequence: Recovery is not reproducible or unsafe completion remains available.

failure_modes.trigger: The repair checkout restores, overwrites, or mixes the user's local legacy docs/plots cleanup.
failure_modes.consequence: An unrelated accepted cleanup is lost or contaminates the evidence PR.
failure_modes.detection: separate worktree plus base-to-head allowlist and cleanup patch/status receipt

failure_modes.trigger: Another plan, full-suite campaign, plot regeneration, or map rerun replaces the shortest map-free recovery path.
failure_modes.consequence: The project returns to process starvation or alters unrelated evidence.
failure_modes.detection: changed-path allowlist and execution receipt requiring prepare/finalize/replay commands
